This '''[[Jedi chapter house/Legends|Jedi chapter house]]''' was located on [[Antar 4/Legends|Antar 4]]. During the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]], the [[Antarian Rangers/Legends|Antarian Rangers]] operated this chapter house, aiding any [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in need of their assistance.
